notes.title: Quality of Life Patch - Patch Notes 11.4.2024
notes.content:
Hello everybody! Thank you all for playing and enjoying Fear the Spotlight.
We're happy to share our patch based on all the feedback and bug reports we've been getting. Thank you for your help, and sorry for any inconvenience these issues may have caused.

Patch Notes:

 Fixed save files in Amy’s house breaking on some PCs
 Fixed shed lock puzzle getting stuck on some PCs
 Fixed keyboard key rebinding
 Improved Japanese translation.
 Improved framerate throughout the house.
 Red numbers in the lockpick minigame now pulse (for colorblind players).
 Updated "Special Thanks."
 Fixed lighting bugs in the girls' locker room and theater.
 Fixed several issues when fading to black between scenes.
 Corrected ceiling geometry in the dark library.
 Fixed retro (wobbly) material on various objects.
 Fixed hanging spotlight in house unexpectedly turning off
 Fixed attic enemy behavior when playing at 120fps+.
 Adjusted SSAO to reduce temporal artifacts.
 Improved edge-cases in the faculty office setup.
 Fixed cell phone rotation bug when toggling menus too quickly.
 Fixed collision on air vents.
 Fixed checkpoints sometimes failing in Chapter 2
 Fixed sliding door lock sometimes getting stuck
 Improved clarity for unlocking Chapter 2
 Added "info" screen to main menu

notes.title: Update Notes - September 18 2023
notes.content:
Hey all! Thank you so much for sharing your love for Fear the Spotlight so far.
All of the video and written feedback has helped us create our first update patch.

Some of the changes made include:

 Skip showdown cutscene when you die/retry
 Added some extra inhalers when the difficulty ramps up near the end
 Fixed file save bug that would sometimes set/reset puzzles incorrectly
 Fixed library collision some players got stuck in.
 Fixed pool audio ignoring volume settings
 Fixed minor enemy AI bugs


Thanks again for the feedback. you are really helping improve the play experience for other players.

notes.title: Full Game Available Soon!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282789/38f7463d40961db90bba7d181faf69cfa94a26d1.png

Full Game Release is Days Away
The full game launches on September 15th 2023. We can't believe we're already here. See the launch trailer above for more of what you can expect in the full game.

Demo Update
It has been amazing and helpful to see reactions and playthroughs of our demo. With your help, and some additional private beta testing, we have been able to fix a ton of tiny issues in the full game. We have also updated the demo build for Windows, Linux, and Mac to include some of these fixes.

Positive Reactions
The responses we've been seeing are amazing. We have a ton of new wishlists on Steam. We've been in the top 10 most popular games on itch.io for about 2 weeks. It's all very surreal!  We know Fear the Spotlight is a very niche game, but when the right people find it, they seem to love it - which is an amazing feeling for us. We really hope that more of the right audience continues to discover it post-launch.

Thank you all so much for your support! We look forward to updating you again when the full game is in your hands!

notes.title: Development Update: We're still Stirring in Sunnyside High
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42282789/0577cceff4cffaab73fc11648593a6345a261237.gif
Welcome back, fans of Fear the Spotlight. It's been a year since you experienced the terror of Sunnyside High, and we've been lurking in the shadows, tirelessly working on bringing you an even more terrifying experience. We can't wait to share some improvements you will see in the full game:

⦁	Physical Puzzles: We've taken inspiration from escape rooms to make the puzzles and exploration more immersive.
⦁	An Intelligent Presence: The enemy has become more than just a predictable obstacle. We've upgraded its mind to keep you on edge and constantly guessing.
⦁	Heart-pounding moments: We've added much needed scary encounters that are not just puzzles or sneaking. These are moments that will test the limits of your courage
⦁	More areas to uncover: We've opened up new areas of the school for you to explore, each with its own puzzles and stories to discover.

Stay tuned for more updates as we approach the final stages of development. The secrets of Sunnyside High are waiting to be uncovered, but are you brave enough to face them?

notes.title: Our demo is a hit! Here's what's next.
notes.content:
Demo Reaction

We released the playable demo 2 weeks ago,  and the reaction has been way huger than we ever expected. Comments, plays, wishlists (please wishlist on Steam), and even trending as 3rd most popular game on all of Itch.io!

It's an amazing feeling to see people actually understand our inspirations and care about the mystery we are putting so much work into building.

Thank you, thank you, thank you SO MUCH. You have no idea.


Your Questions Answered

We've been getting lots of questions (mostly about about the "full game") and I want to try my best to keep you all in the loop:


Release Date
By far the most frequent question is "when is the full game coming out?" 
The short answer is: not soon.
The demo is really all we have so far, the rest of the game only exists on paper. And because we didn't expect a big reaction, our paper design was very minimal (maybe 1-hour long) And would have taken a few months to make.
But the reaction HAS been big, so we've spent these 2 weeks going back to the drawing board and fleshing out the design to include a lot of things we thought we had to cut.
We're still figuring out the exact scope. We're being responsible adults about it because we don't have infinite time and money, and there's only so much we can expect to earn back. But we are really narrowing down on some possibilities.


Ports
We're being asked if the game will be released for consoles and other languages.
We'd love to! But the English PC version is definitely what we'll work on first. We'll worry about other releases when we are further along.
Porting and localization is a LOT of work. Even if other people are helping us, it still takes some of our time. Since our team is only two people every little bit of time matters. 

Difficulty
Another question we're getting: The Spotlight is too easy, will the full game be more challenging?
"Challenge" is really tricky because the right balance can be different for each person.
We made the call to keep The Spotlight pretty easy in the demo so people would actually finish it. In the full game we want him to be INTENSE and we are prepared to put a lot of work into getting it right.

PS1 Look
We're also getting questions about our PS1 look. 
A full breakdown is something we'd love to do for a future update.
Our overall goal is to evoke the PS1 look without being SO strict about it. We're really picking and choosing what WE think looks good.
Some people are saying that our filters are too intense. We'll be constantly tweaking the filters until we finish, so feedback is considered. The full game will also have an accessibility option to tone things down.

Content
And lastly we are getting lots of questions about what will be in the final game. More enemies? More gear? More locations? Etcetera.
The simple answer is an excited "YES"! We have all of those things planned, but we won't know what will make it into the final game until we test and iterate and make sure it's fun.
We're really not sure how much to share about specific content because it dips into spoiler territory. A big element of horror games is the mystery and the surprise of seeing things for the first time. So it might be shame to give things away so early. That's something we'll have to figure out as we continue to update you.


Thank You

We'll try to update you again when we have a better idea of scope and schedule. But now we really need to get back to work!

Thank you so much for following us on this journey. 

Wish us luck!
Bryan and Crista,
Cozy Game Pals
